name: Aakash Dahal
bio: I build developer tools and interactive physics software in TypeScript and Python. Interested in reinforcement learning and robotics.
essentially: I build instruments for AI systems: a harness that catches an agent refunding twice, a proxy that traces every LLM call, and a gate that scans what a coding agent is about to push. Also physics software you can draw into. Next: reinforcement learning and robotics.
